test_case.test_name: One-shot BIOS message-registry test-event trace and version proof
test_case.purpose: After the owner resolves scope, submit at most one approved harmless event and/or read the canonical BIOS registry, proving the exact event-to-registry version chain without damaging existing logs.
required_package: BMC/BIOS build and supported SubmitTestEvent action schema
Canonical registry URI, prefix/language/version and expected value
Pre-event export/capacity, retention/granular cleanup and protected TLS
test_case.test_command: Gate closed until scope and payload are approved. Preserve the log baseline, POST one exact nonempty event only if authorized, capture response/task and correlated event, GET the canonical registry and resolve MessageId to its signed version; never clear unrelated history.
test_case.expected_result: The approved event appears once with the exact identity/severity/alerts and resolves to the expected BIOS registry prefix/language/version, or the separately approved read-only registry checkpoint returns that version.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an owner-approved coverage branch and complete payload→event→MessageId→registry/version trace. Empty/arbitrary POST, uncorrelated event or readability alone cannot pass. Missing scope/payload/version remains Pending.
safety_gate: Export logs and verify capacity before mutation.
Explicit one-shot authorization and unique marker.
No whole-log clear and no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Alert, retention, unrelated-log integrity and verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported action, wrong event/severity or missing correlation stop and preserve all logs; apply only an approved granular retention action, never bulk clear or resubmit.
